clips.title: The story
paras: Northshire Valley shelters Stormwind's newest defenders in northern Elwynn Forest. Natural barriers guard the peaceful valley, where ancient Northshire Abbey, fertile vineyards, and the rich Echo Ridge Mine sustain a pocket of the kingdom. Bandits, kobolds, and displaced predators now trouble its quiet pastures.

Northshire Valley lies behind mountain ridges, with one road south through a fortified gatehouse toward Goldshire and the rest of Elwynn Forest. A clear river crosses the pastures and flows into Crystal Lake. At the valley's heart, ancient Northshire Abbey teaches the Holy Light and trains recruits under the Knights of the Silver Hand and seasoned veterans. Beyond its walls, the fertile Northshire Vineyards and Echo Ridge Mine make this a self-sustaining pocket of Stormwind territory, far from the wars beyond its ridges.

Stormwind's overextended defenses have strained even this sheltered valley. Marshal McBride and his detachment of the Stormwind Guard struggle to maintain order across it. Wolves driven north from blighted Duskwood prowl the woods, while kobolds have overrun Echo Ridge Mine's tunnels. Masked thugs aligned with the Defias Brotherhood harass the vineyards and threaten the abbey grounds, so local commanders recruit every able-bodied civilian who arrives at the gates.
